proof:
The consecutive slopes of $A$ are $(9/20,9/20,9/20,-27/20)$, and those of $B$ are their reversed negatives. Therefore both are concave, and the two displayed inequalities define a compact convex body with positive fibers. At any real base adding and subtracting the affine fiber bounds gives a diamond of radius $(A+B)/2>0$ centered at vertical shift $(A-B)/2$. Hence b170894d1a8b4d11 applies to $C$ and $L=y$, with the actual jointly concave inverse lift. At the five integer bases the radius and shift are precisely the listed arrays, and $|h_z|<R_z$. Their volume and coarea weights follow from $2R_z^2$ and $2(R_z-|h_z|)$. The inverse branches from integrating the diamond widths give cap roots $(1/10,11/20,1,\sqrt{679}/20,1/10)$ and inverse slope magnitudes $(1,1,1,\sqrt{679}/11,1)$.

Reflection through zero preserves the actual mixed measure and the coarea measure on the horizontal section. Both centroids are zero. The reflection of a closed through-zero halfspace is a complementary closed halfspace of equal mass, so its mass is at least half the total. Each horizontal halfspace at zero has half the total because the plane is planar-area-null in each fiber. Their equal section measures and opposite normals give equal-weight balance. At every other point an outward horizontal cap has mass at most half, proving global maximality.

The totals are $151/25$ and $23/5$. The expected values of $|z|$ are $102/151$ and $15/23$, and of $(|z|-1)_+$ are $1/151$ and $2/23$. Subtracting gives the two strict differences, and direct division of the weights by their totals gives the sign pattern.
statement:
Use the diamond $D=\{(x,y):|x|+|y|\le1\}$ and the ordered integer bases $-2,-1,0,1,2$. Put $R=(1/10,1,1,1,1/10)$ and $h=(0,-9/20,0,9/20,0)$. Interpolate $A=R+h$ and $B=R-h$ piecewise affinely and define $C=\{-2\le z\le2,\ |x|+y\le A(z),\ |x|-y\le B(z)\}$. Its actual fibers are $R_zD+(0,h_z)$. Its inverse square-root-tail lift for $y$ is jointly concave. Its mixed centroid is the origin, which is a global depth-$1/2$ point with both opposite horizontal caps active. All five horizontal traces are proper, with coarea centroid zero and balanced opposite normals.

The volume and horizontal section weights are $(1/50,2,2,2,1/50)$ and $(1/5,11/10,2,11/10,1/5)$. The difference of normalized expectations of $|z|$ is $81/3473$ (volume minus section), while for $(|z|-1)_+$ it is $-279/3473$. Thus the two normalized laws are incomparable in convex order, and their normalized weight difference has sign pattern $(-,+,-,+,-)$.
title: Convex-order incomparable volume and section laws in one stationary body
